observations: Photo 0: Front view of a flat-screen TV with a white bezel, placed on a bed. The screen is off, reflecting the room. The LG logo is visible at the bottom center of the bezel.
Photo 1: Side view of the TV, showing a slim profile. A hand holds the top edge. A blue spray bottle and a white cable are on the bed beside it.

Photo 2: Back view of the TV, showing the LG logo, a label with model and serial info, and ports (including what appears to be an HDMI or AV input). A remote control is visible on the bed to the left.

claims.evidence: LG logo visible in photo 0 and photo 2; size is consistent with a 45-inch screen based on proportions and bezel width.
No Firestick is visible in any photo. No proof of its presence.
This is a functional claim about service access, not visible in photos. Cannot be verified remotely.
Only one remote is visible in photo 2. No second remote shown.
Smart TV capability is implied by brand and claim, but no screen shot or proof of Netflix app is visible. Cannot confirm remotely.

risks.proof: Close-up photo of the screen with a bright white image displayed, showing any blemishes or defects.
Photo of the Firestick device and its packaging, or a screen shot showing it connected and working.
Video or photo showing the TV powered on, displaying an image, and ports being used.
Photo of both remotes together or a close-up of the second remote.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having only one remote

proof_requests: Photo of the TV screen turned on, showing a clear image.
Photo of the Firestick device and its packaging, or a screen shot of it in use.
Close-up of the model label on the back (photo 2) to read the model number.
Photo of the TV with a bright white screen to check for dead pixels or damage.
response.reason: The TV is identifiable as an LG model, but key claims (Firestick, double remote, smart features) are unverified or unverifiable remotely. Hidden risks like screen damage or non-functionality cannot be ruled out without further proof. The model number is unreadable, which affects pricing. More photos are needed to confirm functionality and included accessories.
